title: ResearchOps Generic Research Result v2

artifacts.$comment: Optional metadata remains non-blocking at this Research envelope. Authoring tools may lint an array with #/$defs/artifactRequests; ArtifactAcquirer separately enforces path, source, association, and byte safety before any file enters Compose. Do not attach this lint definition to the envelope and thereby reject legacy optional metadata.

$comment: This research-only schema is intentionally just the blocking envelope. Optional artifacts, coverage, warnings, state_updates, metrics, and business detail may be linted separately, but malformed optional data is normalized or quarantined with a warning and never causes record-only silent deletion. The application MUST NOT use this contract to re-evaluate factual relevance. Recipient-group selection and message composition occur later and belong to composition-result.schema.json.

cardragPdfSource.$comment: Values come from the source descriptor; never invent a document ID, hash, or size. The connection ID resolves only in protected application settings. URLs, headers, bearer tokens, and token file paths are forbidden in this descriptor.

officialImageSource.$comment: Request form only. The application checks the exact official host and every destination/redirect, validates PNG/JPEG/GIF bytes, and generates a sanitized URL plus url_sha256 for the immutable Compose/report source. No worker-supplied headers or credentials are accepted.

derived_from.description: Current Research acquisition IDs used as derivative inputs. The application resolves these to verified original hashes; unknown, failed, or foreign receipts are rejected.

artifactRequest.$comment: This optional authoring definition preserves unrelated legacy artifact metadata. Runtime additionally requires canonical safe paths (UTF-8 byte limits), existing record IDs, valid scope, unique IDs/paths, and verified bytes. Missing source means an already-created local Research artifact; it does not authorize a download. Explicit run scope permits local attachment or evidence, with absent/null source and absent/empty record_ids. Evidence is archived and never added to Compose media.
